name: Lentil Bolognese with Wholewheat Spaghetti

components.name: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pan and soften onions, carrots and celery for 8 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste; cook 2 minutes.
Stir in dry washed lentils, crushed tomatoes, stock and Italian herbs. Simmer 25-35 minutes until tender and thick, stirring periodically; add measured extra water only if needed.
Taste and season after the lentils soften, then leave sauce to rest briefly.
Combine pasta with measured sauce or keep separate for better freezer results, and add the vegetarian hard cheese when serving.
Portion five complete meals, with pasta and sauce weights documented at kitchen trial.

components.name: Wholewheat Spaghetti
steps: Boil wholewheat spaghetti in generously boiling water until just firm, drain and retain a small amount of pasta water if needed.
